nodes.label: Catálogo, variables y audiencia
nodes.rationale: Canonical P7.1 requires Meta template status/catalog, variables and accurate counts. Import is conditional on actual reference support.

nodes.label: Consentimiento, programación y pausa
nodes.rationale: Canonical P7.2 requires recipients, scheduling, consent, exclusions, cadence and transactional replacement of blocked transport.

nodes.label: Una outbox y frontera inmediata
nodes.rationale: Canonical P7.3 requires leases/retry/cancellation/uncertainty/reconciliation and revalidation immediately before sending.

nodes.label: Reporte y reintento selectivo
nodes.rationale: Canonical P7.4 separates pending, accepted, sent, delivered, read and failed; report/export/retry must preserve effect history.

nodes.label: Cierre sin efectos falsos
nodes.rationale: Revocation after preparation must block POST; reversal preserves outbox/receipts and reconciles unknown outcomes.

nodes.label: Contrato P6 y copias preservadas
nodes.rationale: P6's own database/profile/volume, frozen release and prior checkpoints remain the parent boundary. No real provider acceptance is inherited.

nodes.label: Comandos cerrados sin aprobación cliente
nodes.rationale: Typed commands bind operation/revision/reason; client cannot set provider approval/actor. Consent requires confirmed evidence/origin/future aware expiry; filters and campaign names have bounds.

nodes.label: Programación local con zona IANA
nodes.rationale: scheduled converts aware inputs to UTC and rejects ambiguous/nonexistent local wall times using both folds and a UTC roundtrip.

nodes.label: API P7 nativa por institución
nodes.rationale: Native endpoints cover accounts/catalog/templates, consent/cadence, campaign draft/preview/actions and report/export. No legacy campaign worker is mounted.

nodes.label: Permisos de campaña y lectura CRM
nodes.rationale: Every transaction authorizes campaigns.manage and crm.read; broadcast module must be enabled. Consent/activation additionally require inbox.write and sensitive actions recent authorization.

nodes.label: Aprobación programada revocable
nodes.rationale: Stored campaign actor/session/auth-version authorizes scheduled work even after session expiry, but explicit session/user/role revocation and disabled modules fence it.

nodes.label: Replay de comandos ligado a actor
nodes.rationale: Campaign save/actions use institutional replay with actor, resource and body, plus revision and explicit review confirmation. Repetition does not create another recipient effect.

nodes.label: Cuenta C10 y catálogo declarado
nodes.rationale: Metadata exposes only institution-owned WhatsApp integrations, current templates, declared CRM programs and active CRM stages; it labels academic authority and import support explicitly.

nodes.label: Versiones de plantilla append-only
nodes.rationale: append creates immutable template versions and separate material revision/fingerprint binding definition/status/account/credential/origin. Sync observations can refresh without silently changing a reviewed campaign's material.

nodes.label: Aprobación de proveedor distinta de operador/controlado
nodes.rationale: Production approved accepts only current non-paused APPROVED origin=provider, fresh observation and matching material/account/credential. controlled is accepted only through an explicit internal test argument.

nodes.label: Creación local no asigna aprobación Meta
nodes.rationale: Template draft is LOCAL_DRAFT origin=operator, with duplicate name/language and version checks; submission remains a separate reviewed provider effect.

nodes.label: Sync paginado de cuenta fija
nodes.rationale: Fetch follows bounded provider cursors under the fixed WABA request path rather than arbitrary next URLs; excess scope/cursor cycles fail closed.

nodes.label: Sync revalida cuenta y credencial
nodes.rationale: Catalog synchronization authenticates before GET and rechecks account row version/secret at commit, appends provider or controlled observations and marks missing rows NOT_FOUND.

nodes.label: Intento durable antes de crear plantilla
nodes.rationale: Template submission records ProviderOperation before network, fixes actor/template/version/account/credential and records confirmed/failed/uncertain; confirmed creation remains PENDING until sync.

nodes.label: Variables por grupo explícitas
nodes.rationale: BODY, HEADER and dynamic URL button variables require exact positional bindings from a closed source set or literal. Missing/extra/empty values reject; header media requires a public URL.

nodes.label: Catálogo vivo, frontera y POST template
nodes.rationale: Actual template send first fetches the provider catalog, verifies ID/name/language/APPROVED/component fingerprint, invokes before_send, then sends WhatsApp type=template.

nodes.label: Audiencia por identidad y contacto canónico
nodes.rationale: Audience uses exact integration identities, CRM filters, merge canonical contact, closed/human/no-contact/consent/account/template exclusions and current variable rendering; duplicate contacts are excluded in the current list.

nodes.label: Consentimiento explícito versionado
nodes.rationale: Current consent is an append-only per-identity stream with evidence, origin, actor and expiry. API verifies integration ownership and revocation cancels prepared/queued work.

nodes.label: No contactar se conserva por grupo
nodes.rationale: Any active-group noContact decision excludes the canonical contact; a bare phone/contact is never a grant.

nodes.label: Conteos y exclusiones reales del snapshot
nodes.rationale: Preview distinguishes matched, eligible and excluded, returns rendered rows/exclusion reasons and labels declared CRM authority rather than verified SIIE.

nodes.label: Edición cambia revisión y epoch
nodes.rationale: Editing requires draft/paused state, rejects sending/uncertain attempts, cancels unsent work and increments revision/epoch while clearing actor approval.

nodes.label: Preparación sin enviar
nodes.rationale: Prepare/activate stores current consent/control/account/template/canonical-target snapshots and durable actor approval. Resume can create a fresh reviewed attempt only for a cancelled, never-dispatched job while keeping history.

nodes.label: Pausa conserva intentos y frena cola
nodes.rationale: Pause/cancel advance campaign revision/epoch, cancel queued SendJob and prepared recipients, retaining attempt history; in-flight validation observes the new state.

nodes.label: Destinatario vinculado a C10
nodes.rationale: Native Recipient references institution campaign, C10 identity/current SendJob and CRM contact/conversation, while retaining consent/version/control/account/campaign snapshot.

nodes.label: Historial de intentos sin segunda cola
nodes.rationale: Attempt primary key is recipient/attempt number and QueueId is institution-unique; each points to the same C10 SendJob rather than another dispatcher/outbox.

nodes.label: Productor acotado y transaccional
nodes.rationale: Worker selects due prepared recipients under native transactions, validates current audience/approval, reserves cadence and atomically creates message, C10 SendJob/route, Attempt and current recipient linkage.

nodes.label: La cola exige vínculo durable y payload exacto
nodes.rationale: ready resolves QueueId through Attempt→Recipient and rechecks campaign revision/epoch, consent/control/account/canonical target, route and rendered/template payload before treating it as broadcast.

nodes.label: Outbox reutiliza frontera específica P7
nodes.rationale: Only the P7 profile plus durable Attempt linkage admits broadcast; unlinked marketing payloads remain blocked. Dispatcher forwards a final callback for P7 and validates the lease.

nodes.label: El adaptador exige callback de envío
nodes.rationale: origin=broadcast is routed to the explicit template adapter only when before_send exists. Normal text/media paths retain their prior behavior.

nodes.label: Un único dispatcher con productor P7
nodes.rationale: Workers keeps the same EventWorker/MediaWorker/Dispatcher; P7 adds receipt reconciliation and a bounded producer before that dispatcher, not another emitter.

nodes.label: Cadencia de cuenta y cuota técnica
nodes.rationale: Producer reserves the daily integration quota; the existing dispatcher callback now also checks and advances shared NextAt at the actual POST frontier. Native institutional message quota remains separate and uncertainty retains its accounting.

nodes.label: Retry sólo de fallo definitivo no aceptado
nodes.rationale: Explicit selected recipients may retry only failed jobs without provider ExternalId and within attempt limits; current eligibility is checked and prior Attempt rows remain.

nodes.label: Recuperación genérica no elude P7
nodes.rationale: The shared channel recovery helper rejects native broadcast linkage and directs the user to the broadcast-specific workflow; accepted/uncertain work is not silently reset.

nodes.label: Incertidumbre y reservas conservadas
nodes.rationale: Expired sending leases become uncertain. Provider acceptance is distinct from receipt delivery; known failure releases quota, unknown effect retains reservation and never auto-requeues.

nodes.label: Recibos firmados por cuenta exacta
nodes.rationale: Verified endpoint/application/integration evidence projects states by exact integration and ExternalId. P7 rejects unmatched delivery projection into durable quarantine rather than silently processing it.

nodes.label: Reconciliación de recibo adelantado
nodes.rationale: reconcile_receipts requeues only authenticated durable events quarantined as delivery_unmatched once a matching account/external ID is present; no new send is produced.

nodes.label: Reporte desde estado de la cola actual
nodes.rationale: Native report reads current C10 attempt state, supports state/search filters and SQL pagination, exposes attempt count plus authenticated event-observation timestamps and explicit reply attribution. Provider acceptance remains distinct from sent/delivered/read evidence.

nodes.label: CSV autorizado neutraliza fórmulas
nodes.rationale: Export is explicit and authorized, includes recipient/identity/status/attempt/provider fields and prefixes formula-leading cells instead of exporting active spreadsheet formula text.

nodes.label: Mensajería masiva en el shell real
nodes.rationale: The actual InstitutionShell mounts BroadcastWorkspace only for native broadcast capability and campaigns.manage; it does not mount the legacy campaigns panel.

nodes.label: UI con borrador y nonce estables
nodes.rationale: CampaignEditor preserves dirty document state, draft navigation protection, explicit review and command nonce. Sensitive activate is additionally gated by inbox.write.

nodes.label: Cuenta, plantilla, variables y revisión visibles
nodes.rationale: The native editor selects owned integration/template and explicit variable/filter/schedule fields, shows exclusions, and exposes activate/resume, pause/cancel and selected retry.

nodes.label: UI separa catálogo, borrador y proveedor controlado
nodes.rationale: TemplatePanel labels operator draft, controlled provider and real catalog separately, with explicit sync, submit-for-review and local pause controls; no manual approved status field.

nodes.label: UI de consentimiento y cadencia por cuenta
nodes.rationale: Account-specific consent/cadence editors require evidence/origin/review and display current expiry/version. Zero proof of consent is not transformed into eligibility.

nodes.label: Perfil y permisos P7 propios
nodes.rationale: P7 target/principal/partition are closed to named trial/fault/recovery copies; rights are additive and template/attempt/consent history is SELECT/INSERT, journal SELECT only.

nodes.label: Release aditivo encadenado a P6
nodes.rationale: The P7 manifest pins two DDL files and expected model under the frozen P6 release; this review does not apply it.

nodes.label: Migrador SQL2019 explícito con drift/diario
nodes.rationale: Runner source enforces engine15/compat150, exact target/identity/release/parent history, locks, durable journal and model drift checks. Reading it is not executing it.

nodes.label: Recuperación nativa y partición cerrada
nodes.rationale: Backup/restore and media-copy helpers constrain target/table partition and fingerprints. The public result separately records150 stable SQL tables/733 rows and2 uncertain jobs; media had0 ready blobs and no populated-blob credit.

nodes.label: Agentes y P6 siguen en la composición P7
nodes.rationale: The P7 profile retains governed knowledge composition/private memory and effective replay binding from P6; static hooks alone do not prove regression execution.

nodes.label: Tests puros de protocolo de plantilla
nodes.rationale: Inspected tests cover typed authority/consent/schedule, variable components/cursors, GET→frontier→POST order and unapproved rejection. This reviewer did not execute them.

nodes.label: Calificador API controlado
nodes.rationale: Qualifier source defines native account/template sync, audience/consent, enqueue, template POST and export scenarios. It is source coverage, not real Meta acceptance.

nodes.label: Calificador de concurrencia y recibos controlados
nodes.rationale: Qualifier source covers consent/pause/takeover at the effect frontier, timeout, early/out-of-order signed receipts, schedule, expired lease and producer quota sharing. It was not run by this reviewer. Its current source explicitly supports a 14-check retained checkpoint plus 8 continuation checks.

nodes.label: Calificador de almacenamiento y recuperación
nodes.rationale: Source defines migration faults, concurrency/drift/rights and native populated recovery qualification. Public result receipts are separate evidence; the reviewer did not execute this source.

nodes.label: Cadencia reservada en frontera de POST
nodes.rationale: The actual effect callback rechecks the shared NextAt and atomically advances it before POST; a concurrent waiting effect is safely deferred to queued/pending and its technical reservation released. Backlog spacing correction is code-observed; public extras results record this backlog correction as passed with controlled transport.

nodes.label: Reanudación explícita sin efecto iniciado
nodes.rationale: Preparation/resume admits only a cancelled prior queue with no provider ExternalId and zero dispatch attempts; it clears the current pointer for a new reviewed attempt while retaining prior Attempt rows. Accepted, sending or uncertain effects are not reset.

nodes.label: Dedupe por efectos previos del grupo canónico
nodes.rationale: Audience now inspects campaign attempts with an ExternalId or sending/uncertain state and excludes another identity of the same current canonical contact group. The final recipient check reuses that audience, protecting merges after an earlier effect.

nodes.label: Creación incierta bloqueada hasta reconciliación
nodes.rationale: Template create now records template identity/version in durable operation metadata, rejects new submissions while that template has a running/uncertain effect and rechecks context before POST. A positive catalog sync reconciles the operation; absence is not fabricated failure.

nodes.label: Cierre tras aceptación de todos los intentos
nodes.rationale: The producer aggregates completion only when every recipient has a provider ExternalId and none remains prepared/queued/sending/uncertain. Completion means dispatch acceptance, not proof of delivery.

nodes.label: Identificador de proveedor comparado con BIN2
nodes.rationale: Receipt reconciliation explicitly collates normalized JSON external ID as Latin1_General_100_BIN2 before comparison with the account-scoped C10 provider ID; this is a source correction, not a new executed SQL result. Public runtime results record early signed receipt reconciliation as passed under controlled fixtures.

nodes.label: Respuesta atribuida sólo con contexto explícito
nodes.rationale: Report timestamps derive from processed authenticated events. Reply attribution requires provider.context.id to equal the outgoing provider ID and the event author to match the identity, not merely later inbound traffic.

nodes.label: API controlada: 15 comprobaciones
nodes.rationale: 15 API checks over an owned SQL2019 qualification copy; 2 controlled POSTs and zero real provider calls. Operator drafts/catalog injection confer no actual Meta approval.

nodes.label: Runtime controlado: 22 checks con continuidad
nodes.rationale: 22 recorded passing checks, including 14 retained checkpoint checks and 8 continuation checks. The current-process controlled_POSTs=0 field applies only to that continuation, not to all 22 scenarios.

nodes.label: Fronteras adicionales: 6 checks con continuidad
nodes.rationale: 6 recorded passing checks: 5 retained from the controlled checkpoint plus the custom-role permission continuation. This is not a fresh execution of all six checks.

nodes.label: Almacenamiento: 12 checks sobre SQL Server 2019
nodes.rationale: 12 storage/migration fault/concurrency/drift/least-privilege checks reported passed on separate owned qualification copies.

nodes.label: Recuperación SQL poblada: 7 checks
nodes.rationale: 7 populated native SQL recovery checks passed; stable fingerprint covers 150 stable tables/733 rows and preserves two uncertain queue IDs. It does not claim all160 tables are stable or populated media recovery.

nodes.label: Demo persistida: 4 checks sin aprobación ficticia
nodes.rationale: 4 demo checks passed: inherited 8 contacts/8 conversations/26 messages/6 knowledge remain, with explicit operator/account draft additions and no fabricated approval, consent, recipient or send.

nodes.label: Preservación académica y P6
nodes.rationale: 4 preservation checks passed: fresh P6 business fingerprint, 30 academic tables and 8/8/26 inherited rows. Windows SIIE was not requeried; main P7 has no real provider effect.

nodes.label: Navegador integrado: 18 checks
nodes.rationale: 18 integrated-browser checks reported passed for native forms, persistence, sections, mobile and no runtime errors. This reviewer did not use a browser.

nodes.label: 1382 preimágenes exactas sin SQL
nodes.rationale: 1382 exact frozen preimages reported replayed offline, without SQL and without changing parent checker bytes.

nodes.label: Suites: 322 backend y 323 frontend; tipos y lint
nodes.rationale: Current source-bound receipt reports backend 322 / frontend 323 passed and typecheck/lint exit0. These are helper-produced results, not executions by this reviewer.

nodes.label: Compilación SQL2019 revertida
nodes.rationale: Native SQL2019 compilation report: engine15/compat150/160 tables, transaction rolled back and no academic DDL/DML.

nodes.label: Volumen propio: cero blobs listos
nodes.rationale: Source read-only volume copied to the own P7 volume with zero ready blobs. Populated-blob recovery is explicitly unqualified.

nodes.label: Despliegue p7es-r3 con perfil propio
nodes.rationale: Main own-profile SQL2019 deployment p7es-r3 at4178 reports202 Python application files matching the workspace, own media volume and the retained stopped P6 container. That app-file count does not by itself hash every tools source.

nodes.label: Calificador de cadencia, merge y rol propio
nodes.rationale: Controlled scenarios include backlog spacing, post-accept merge and uncertain template creation; a custom role with campaigns.manage/crm.read but without inbox.write is denied activation. Five prior checks are retained for the role continuation.

nodes.label: Pruebas UI nativas de broadcasting
nodes.rationale: Frontend test source covers native draft/catalog/preview/actions with explicit consent and distinct provider approval, plus intent/draft-state guards. The public source-bound suite receipt is separate evidence.

nodes.label: Meta real y cierre P4 aún pendientes
nodes.rationale: The API receipt explicitly has actual_Meta_catalog_approved=false, actual_external_receipts=false and real_provider_calls=0. Controlled catalog/transports cannot satisfy the remaining institutional Meta/P4 acceptance.

nodes.label: Definiciones de catálogo mediante conjuntos
nodes.rationale: metadata resolves object module/default/check definitions through joins and preserves schema/name/type/definition projection and ordering. This avoids per-object scalar definition expansion without changing the stated catalog shape.

nodes.label: Definiciones DML y DDL sin función escalar
nodes.rationale: Both table DML trigger and database DDL trigger sets now read sys.sql_modules.definition through joins. The earlier residual scalar calls are absent in the current source.

nodes.label: Sonda de equivalencia sólo en FAULT propio
nodes.rationale: The qualifier enforces the P7 FAULT target, creates module/default/check/encrypted/DML/DDL probes, compares definition bytes with scalar OBJECT_DEFINITION and checks the academic snapshot before/after. Source inspection does not mean this reviewer ran it.

nodes.label: Catálogo: 5 checks y 15 objetos
nodes.rationale: 5 native catalog-equivalence checks passed on an owned FAULT copy:15 objects plus1 DML/1 database DDL trigger, encrypted NULL preservation and30 academic tables unchanged. The qualifier creates only its own probe objects; this reviewer ran no SQL.

nodes.label: Reinicio real: 157 tablas estables
nodes.rationale: Real container restart report passed:157 stable table fingerprints, same profile/TLS target and append-only P7 state preserved. This157-table restart set differs from the150-table populated SQL recovery set.

nodes.label: Navegador tras reinicio: 7 checks
nodes.rationale: 7 post-restart browser checks passed: same session,157 stable-table fingerprints, P6 knowledge/source/confidence/memory/DNA and P7 campaign/template/cadence persisted; no real provider calls.

nodes.label: Incidente de catálogo y reparación documentados
nodes.rationale: Public coordinator narrative says an OBJECT_DEFINITION startup query held the P7 authority lock; only the validated P7 session and Docker SQL copies were restarted to clear rollback. The document states exact profile/digest/TLS/permissions/drift preserved with no ticket reissue. This agent did not perform or independently observe that operation.

nodes.rationale: Current coordinator ledger records P7.2/P7.3 accepted in local controlled SQL2019 scope, P7 technical144/175=82.29% and whole phase unaccepted. Global counters are 201/279 done milestones and 33/56 accepted criteria. This is observed acceptance metadata, not acceptance assigned by the reviewer.
